title: California security deposit cap and return rules (AB 12)
requirement: Since July 1, 2024, a landlord may charge no more than one month's rent as a security deposit; small landlords may charge two months. Deposits must be returned within 21 days with an itemized statement, and landlords must offer a move-out walk-through inspection.
key_value: 1 month's rent; 2 months for small landlords
coverage_conditions: All California residential tenancies. Landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total, held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC of natural persons, may charge two months' rent.

conditions.who: landlord owning only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total

coverage_quotes: Starting July 1, 2024, landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total can charge up to two months' rent for furnished and unfurnished units if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or limited liability company (LLC) where all members are natural persons

exemptions: Landlords owning only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total (natural person, family trust, or LLC with all natural-person members) may charge up to two months' rent.
quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units

title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance security deposit interest
requirement: Landlords of units fully or partially covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year, with a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the year ends.
coverage_conditions: Units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
